# Training data summary: scout-large 0.1.2

Voluntary summary following the structure of the EU AI Office template for the public summary of training content (July 2025). The model is not a general-purpose AI model; see the AI Act classification.

## 1. General information

- Model: scout-large 0.1.2; provider: Martin Habedank (private person).
- Modality: text (German and English).
- Training data: 87 published source documents; labels produced by a teacher language model (synthetic labels).

## 3. Data processing

- The training texts of this version were collected before the project's compliance harness existed. At collection time robots.txt was checked; the other opt-out signals (TDM reservation, noai, ai.txt) were checked retrospectively on 2026-10-08 and are recorded per source in the compliance register. E-mail addresses, phone numbers, user handles and profile links were removed by pattern redaction and a local model review before labeling; a re-scan of the stored training texts on 2026-10-08 found no remaining personal identifiers. Special categories of personal data were not filtered at collection; a lexicon count on 2026-10-08 flagged mostly general accessibility topics (for example wheelchair access) in parliamentary hearings.
- The collected texts are not published.
